summary: InflaRx N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with MD&A and a press release. The filing reports operating losses, R&D spending, and foreign exchange effects, but includes no transaction, strategic action, or shareholder-return event. It is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, with no M&A, tender, spin-off, or restructuring activity. The exhibits are incorporated into existing Form S-8 registration statements. There is no deal or special-situation characteristic to analyze; the appropriate classification is None.
